layoutPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new high-resolution terrain chunk for The Lantern Atlas level editor. Image 1 is a STYLE, CAMERA and STONE-SCALE reference, not a layout to copy. Paint a NEW flat parcel-yard courtyard ground plate for a living market district. Match the warm cream and honey cobblestones, small gray stones, olive grass, granular soil, hand-painted edges and elevated isometric orthographic camera of the reference. The terrain fills the entire rectangular canvas, no horizon. Layout: a broad accessible cobblestone courtyard covering roughly the central 70 percent, an open broad road enters at the middle of the left edge and exits at the middle of the right edge, another wide path exits the center of the bottom edge. Softly curved grass-and-soil building lots occupy the upper-left and upper-right corners and a small garden planting lot in the lower-left. Keep all roads connected at the same level; no stairs, no water, no walls crossing routes. Only low curbs around the grassy lots. Keep the center open for movable courier crates, market stalls and residents that will be separate editor objects. TERRAIN ONLY: absolutely no buildings, trees, furniture, crates, lamps, plants taller than grass, vehicles, people, shadows from unseen objects, text, labels, borders or UI. Newly painted fine surface detail appropriate to close game-camera inspection, not a blurry enlarged overview. Output a 3072 by 2048 pixel landscape canvas at highest native detail. It represents a 768 by 512 world-unit chunk at 4 painting pixels per world unit. Preserve that close-up detail density throughout.

daySectionPrompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: high-resolution close-up game terrain source section, parcel-yard day 0-0. Input image 1 is the EXACT GEOMETRY EDIT TARGET. Redraw it at approximately 1494 by 1052 pixels (same 432:304 aspect), adding newly painted fine detail: clean individual warm cobblestone edges and mortar grains, tiny cracks, pebbles, delicate grass blades and soil texture. This section represents exactly 432 by 304 game world units and must have at least 1450 by 1024 native image pixels, matching the close-up source density used on latest main. Preserve EVERY road edge, curb curve, green patch shape, intersection and location at the frame edges. Preserve the elevated orthographic camera, paving scale, warm daylight color and shadows. This is one of four overlapping registered source sections, so do not rearrange, crop, zoom, rotate or invent features; the top, bottom, left and right edge layout must remain identical to input. TERRAIN ONLY, no raised objects, houses, trees, furniture, crates, lamps, people, water, text, labels, border or UI. Fine painted surface detail, no photographic noise, blur, sharpening halos or flat vector look. Output only the finished terrain section.
